selection.rule: Two paired-paragraph speakers per grade/gender stratum, sorted pools and fixed RNG seed; shuffle all 24 recordings once. No selection by duration, transcript quality, miscues, audio or ASR outcome.

execution.warmup: No separate inference warmup; first reading includes first-inference effects.

split_anchor_evidence.kind: Complete exact split-anchor support in emitted decision buffers; diagnostic evidence, not an instrumented permission-route trace.

pending_effect_evidence.kind: Observed pending lifecycle events in the fresh app streams

provider_annotation_review.note: Provider annotations flag review candidates. Substitutions may be acceptable pronunciation attempts; these counts are not an effect-accuracy or latency score.

cases.transcription_note: User accepted the supplied target phrase; this is not a separate verbatim transcription by the user.
cases.time_meaning: User supplies an approximate phrase end at 0:10 in the excerpt, corresponding to about 11.36 seconds in the original. Whole-second human cue, not an independently verified acoustic alignment or latency measurement.
cases.diagnosis: ASR substitutes chip for the first sheep and retains it. The ordinary spelling and contextual phonetic endpoint rules reject that substitution. Progress later reaches the checkpoint after following words; no supported endpoint for this occurrence arrives to resolve it.

post_evaluation_human_review.scope: Only listed cases have user listening confirmation. Phrase-location marks are not verified word endpoints.

unrelated_speech_replay.kind: Saved ASR callbacks from four existing fresh unrelated-speech streams, replayed against six frozen passage manifests; not additional fresh audio trials.

limits: Held-out speaker IDs on the same six familiar Indian MPS paragraph texts; not held-out books or Singapore-accent validation.
Single fresh stream per recording. Both replay ledgers use the identical frozen matcher and ASR callbacks; their agreement is an audit, not an improvement comparison.
Human listening applies only to explicitly attached post-evaluation reviews; no exact word-end timestamps are verified.
Effects emitted/withheld/unreached/skipped are operational outcomes, not pronunciation or checkpoint precision/recall.
Raw recordings, provider transcripts and review clips remain local under ignored output/.
